prompts: Use collaboration.spawn_agent exactly once with agent_type fixture_reader, task_name fixture_read_task, and message exactly "First call mcp__child_gate__wait_for_root with no arguments and wait for its success. The root must not read files, call the child gate, use shell/network/other tools, or create another child.
